design.decision: Your team plays a two-suit hand every round, void in [♣] and [♥], so it bids on ruffing power and [♦] length, and every [♦] payoff becomes a build-around.
design.opponent: Shown on the first [♣] or [♥] lead; opponents hold all of those suits with nobody to follow, so they lead [♠] to strip trumps and attack the long [♦]s.
design.rationale: This is the legendary [♦] build-around, the broad version of ra-clubs-to-diamonds: two voids are a strong Spades edge on their own, and the combo with [♦] hold payoffs is deliberately explosive but needs a rare-plus-legendary assembly. Duplicate [♦] cards follow the kernel's existing tie rules for synthetic copies.
